title: Linked List Components
description:
You are given the `head` of a singly linked list containing unique integer values and an integer array `nums` that is a subset of the linked list values.

Return the number of connected components in `nums`, where two values belong to the same connected component if they appear consecutively in the linked list.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is n, with 1 <= n <= 10^4.
0 <= Node.val < n, and all values in the linked list are unique.
1 <= nums.length <= n, all values in nums are unique, and every value in nums appears in the linked list.
hints: Insert all elements of `nums` into a hash set for O(1) membership lookups.
Walk the linked list once and increment the component counter whenever a node's value is in the set and either it is the tail or its successor's value is not in the set.

examples.explanation: Nodes 0 and 1 are adjacent (component 1), and 3 is isolated (component 2), giving 2 components.
Nodes 0 and 1 form one component, and 3 and 4 form a second component.
All nodes in the list are present in nums, forming 1 single connected component.
